
  ╭─────────────────────────────────────────────╮
  │  /evolve  (/self-improve)                   │
  │  Evolve Controls                            │
  ╰─────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  Summary:
    Control verified learning, proposals, and reviewed Python extensions.

  Usage:
    /evolve
    /evolve status
    /evolve on|off
    /evolve auto on|off
    /evolve learning on|off
    /evolve extensions on|off
    /evolve settings
    /evolve analyze|review|history|stats

  Details:
    Use one command surface for evolution-related settings:
    
      • status              - Show every current state
      • on / off            - Toggle the proposal engine
      • auto on / off       - Toggle automatic proposals
      • learning on / off   - Toggle learning collection
      • extensions on / off - Toggle reviewed local extensions
      • settings            - Configure individual learning modules
      • analyze             - Create proposals from verified outcomes
      • review              - Explicitly approve or reject proposals
      • history / stats     - Inspect retained learning data

  Examples:
    $ /evolve status
    $ /evolve on
    $ /evolve learning off
    $ /evolve analyze

  Tips:
    Tip: Proposal analysis and self-extension are disabled by default.
    Tip: Generated Python always requires explicit approval.

  Related: /settings  /selfmod
